severity_matrix.definition: Service-stopping: pipeline completely down or producing garbage results
severity_matrix.escalation: StoryOps Planner + DevOps Eng war room

severity_matrix.definition: Degraded: pipeline functional but quality below contractual thresholds
severity_matrix.escalation: DevOps Eng leads, StoryOps Planner informed

severity_matrix.definition: Watch: metrics deviating from baseline but within safe operating range

failure_classes.name: provider_failure
failure_classes.diagnose: check API status, request IDs, error codes
failure_classes.contain: switch to fallback or pause ingestion
failure_classes.recover: re-run failed batch after provider recovery

failure_classes.name: data_quality_failure
failure_classes.recover: re-extract from source or mark permanently unresolved

failure_classes.name: provenance_failure
failure_classes.contain: prevent nodes without provenance from entering graph

failure_classes.name: schema_failure
failure_classes.diagnose: check vector dimensions, index format, checksum matches
failure_classes.contain: prevent malformed vectors from entering index
